externalDocs.description: Find out more about Atlassian products and services.

tags.description:
This resource represents issue type screen schemes. Use it to:

 *  get issue type screen schemes and a list of the projects that use them.
 *  create issue type screen schemes.
 *  update issue type screen schemes.
 *  delete issue type screen schemes.
 *  associate issue type screen schemes with projects.
 *  append issue type to screen scheme mappings to issue type screen schemes.
 *  remove issue type to screen scheme mappings from issue type screen schemes.
 *  update default screen scheme of issue type screen scheme.
tags.name: Issue type screen schemes

tags.description: This resource represents the screen tab fields used to record issue details. Use it to get, add, move, and remove fields from screen tabs.
tags.name: Screen tab fields

tags.description: This resource represents the screen tabs used to record issue details. Use it to get, create, update, move, and delete screen tabs.
tags.name: Screen tabs

tags.description:
This resource represents the screens used to record issue details. Use it to:

 *  get details of all screens.
 *  get details of all the fields available for use on screens.
 *  create screens.
 *  delete screens.
 *  update screens.
 *  add a field to the default screen.
tags.name: Screens

get.description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of the screens a field is used in.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the field to return screens for.
parameters.name: fieldId

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information about screens in the response. This parameter accepts `tab` which returns details about the screen tabs the field is used in.
parameters.name: expand

application/json.example: {"isLast":false,"maxResults":1,"startAt":0,"total":5,"values":[{"id":10001,"name":"Default Screen","description":"Provides for the update of all system fields.","tab":{"id":10000,"name":"Fields Tab"}}]}

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.

get.description:

parameters.name: id

parameters.description: String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with issue type screen scheme name.
parameters.name: queryString

parameters.description:
[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:

 *  `name` Sorts by issue type screen scheme name.

basicAuth.description: You can access this resource via basic auth.

scopes.delete:project:jira: Delete projects and their details, such as issue types, project lead, and avatars.
scopes.manage:jira-configuration: Configure Jira settings that require the Jira administrators permission, for example, create projects and custom fields, view workflows, manage issue link types.
scopes.manage:jira-project: Create and edit project settings and create new project-level objects, for example, versions, components.
scopes.manage:jira-webhook: Manage Jira webhooks. Enables an OAuth app to register and unregister dynamic webhooks in Jira. It also provides for fetching of registered webhooks.
scopes.read:email-address:jira: View email addresses of all users regardless of the user's profile visibility settings.
scopes.read:jira-user: View user information in Jira that you have access to, including usernames, email addresses, and avatars.
scopes.read:jira-work: Read project and issue data. Search for issues and objects associated with issues (such as attachments and worklogs).
scopes.write:avatar:jira: Create and update system and custom avatars.
scopes.write:comment.property:jira: Create and update issue comment properties.
scopes.write:field-configuration-scheme:jira: Create and update field configuration schemes.
scopes.write:field.default-value:jira: Create and update field default values.
scopes.write:filter.default-share-scope:jira: Create and update filter default share scopes.
scopes.write:issue-link-type:jira: Create and update issue link types.
scopes.write:issue-type-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type-screen-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type screen schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type.property:jira: Create and update issue type properties.
scopes.write:issue-worklog.property:jira: Create and update issue worklog properties.
scopes.write:issue.remote-link:jira: Create and update issue remote links.
scopes.write:issue.time-tracking:jira: Create and update issue time trackings.
scopes.write:jira-work: Create and edit issues in Jira, post comments, create worklogs, and delete issues.
